02 · Profile

A business perspective
behind the numbers.

Analytics is more useful when the numbers stay connected to the question the business is actually trying to answer.

I’m Mostafa Mohamed, a Data Analyst with one year of hands-on freelance experience.

I work across data preparation, analysis, visualization, dashboards, and reporting using Excel, SQL, Power BI, Python, and Tableau. My goal is not to make data look complicated — it is to make the useful part easier to understand and act on.
